networkEvidence.source: AzureDiagnostics / AzureFirewallNetworkRule via controller managed identity
networkEvidence.interpretation: Seven exact-window named firewall denies independently corroborate the U5 runner classification; the collector transport failure alone is not denial evidence.
limitations: Firewall records do not contain the trial run ID; correlation uses the exact execution window and source/destination/port/rule tuple.
This is one non-counted Functions P3 U5 pilot and does not establish overall measured readiness gates.
